name: list_union_variant_hint_int_arm
description: UNION BURN-DOWN — the MUTATE-TO-DIVERGE twin of list_union_variant_hint_float_arm: the SAME schema and the same second element, with element 0 mutated from 1.5 to 1. Now element 0 try_casts on the INT arm, so element 1's hint is int — which does not change the ordered outcome (int is arm 0 anyway) and 2^53+1 keeps full precision. Emitting 9007199254740992 here (or 9007199254740993 there) would be a divergence, so the pair pins the hint's DIRECTION, not just its presence. want live-captured from BAML v0.223 final parse.
